notes: Both לְ before king are unrepresented: the ASV writes and her king as a bare coordinated object (rule 40).
shall ye take for a prey is read as one light-verb rendering of תָּבֹזּוּ headed on prey; the competing reading would attach for a prey to the following לָכֶם phrase (rule 44).
The dative לְ of שִׂים־לְךָ is unrepresented while its suffix takes thee (rule 40).
